content.short: Storm Trade is a TON derivatives platform for perpetual markets, leveraged positions, and Telegram-based trading access.
content.description: Storm Trade offers self-custodial perpetual trading on TON through both a web interface and a Telegram bot. Official materials focus on leveraged positions, wallet based execution, TON Space integration, and markets that extend beyond crypto into categories such as commodities and equities. The platform is designed for users who want derivatives exposure on TON, with staking programs and campaign mechanics supporting the core trading experience and helping build a more active trading environment.
